description: The whole text thread between one of YOUR characters and someone it has dated, oldest first: each date as a marker, the morning-after texts right behind it (kind: morning_after), and their texts between dates (kind: between_dates), whoever wrote them. A couple from the swipe deck also has when they matched (kind: matched) and when both said yes to a date (kind: date_agreed). Newest page first (60 items); pass before: cursor for the page before it, or after: the newest id you've seen to get only what's new.

after.description: An item id: returns only what came after it.

before.description: A cursor from an earlier page: returns the page before it.

name: read_texts
title: Read a couple's texts
